title: Two Weeks
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott gives his two-week notice at Dunder Mifflin and reveals his plan to start his own paper company. He attempts to recruit coworkers, including Jim, Pam, Oscar, Stanley, and Dwight, with mixed reactions. Pam ultimately decides to join Michael, surprising Jim. Meanwhile, Charles announces personnel changes in the office following Michael's departure. The episode captures the office's varied responses to Michael's exit and the uncertainty surrounding his new venture.

main_threads.thread: Michael's decision to quit Dunder Mifflin and start his own paper company, including his attempts to recruit coworkers and the office's reaction to his departure.
